theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_frobenius_approximation
theorems.statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E] (σ : (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (B : Finset ℕ), ∃ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime ∧ ℓ ∉ B ∧ ∃ P : ValuationSubring (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), P.LiesOverPrime ℓ ∧ ∃ τ : (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ), P.IsFrobeniusAt τ ℓ ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, τ x = σ x
theorems.natural_summary: Restrict σ to E, apply the accepted finite Frobenius theorem, and use the accepted unique-lifting theorem to obtain the required absolute Frobenius agreeing with σ on E.
